title: 🔆🔅 October 11th- The third oil tanker struck a naval mine and burst into flames.
text:
🔆🔅 October 11th- The third oil tanker struck a naval mine and burst into flames."

"🔹Yesterday evening, Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) Navy Public Relations Office: A shuttle tanker carrying 750,000 barrels of crude oil ignored warnings and alerts from the IRGC Navy and attempted to pass through an unauthorized route. It struck a naval mine and suffered an explosion and a severe fire."
